notes.title: Tank Simulator is coming soon!
notes.content:
Dear fans of our game. Our work is coming to an end and the release of our game Tank Simulator is approaching!

We are aiming to release the game on February 20, barring any major setbacks.

We hope you will like our game.



What you will find in the game.

- Historical battles from the capture of Czechoslovakia to the fall of Berlin

- you'll see the Soviet Union, North Africa, the mountains and the wastelands

- local multiplayer for two players - infantry, combined with tank

- custom infantry and tank groups




Battle overview:

- Expulsion of the Czechs from the Sudetenland in 1938

- Invasion of Poland (1939)

- Siege of Warsaw (1939)

- Battle of France (1940)

- Operation Barbarossa (1941)

- Battle of Moscow (1941)

- Siege of Tobruk (1941)

- Battle of Stalingrad (1942-1943)

- Battle of the Kursk Arch (1943)

- Second Battle of El Alamein (1942)

- Battle of Caen (1944)

- Battle of the Ardennes (1945)

- Battle of Berlin (1945)

notes.title: New patch - multiplayer added!
notes.content:
Overview of new features in the new version of Tank Simulator demo.

Local multiplayer
- Now you can play with friends. One player controls a tank, the other an infantry team with a cannon or mortar.

Daily, night battles
- Each battle can be run in 3 modes. Day, night and dynamic time

New units
- We have added over 20 new infantry units. It also got a brand new AI

- We fixed both maps. For Prokhorovka, among other things, the entire destructible environment, including the forest, is now


Lots of other new features, fixes and improvements.

Download the demo and have fun!

notes.title: New features in the demo
notes.content:
Today we released a new patch for our game. You'll find fixes for many small things in the game demo, improved enemy AI and lots of other new features.

The patch includes:
- fixes and modifications to the demo
- improved tank AI
- Improved infantry AI.
